title: XRP Healthcare AI ($XRPHAI) MEXC Listing Confirmed 🚀 First Market Access Explained
description:
In my previous video, I introduced you to this project and we explored its concept, vision, and overall potential in detail.

Now, there’s a major update — the project has confirmed its $XRPHAI utility token will go live on MEXC on April 27 at 10:00 AM UTC, marking a significant milestone and opening the door to a much wider global audience.

🌐 Project Website:
https://www.xrphealthcare.ai

XRP Healthcare is focused on transforming the healthcare sector by combining blockchain technology with real-world medical solutions. The project aims to improve accessibility, transparency, and efficiency in healthcare systems.

🚀 MEXC Listing Announcement:
https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/first-in-market-17827791535042

This will be the first time XRPHAI is available on the open market, with no prior exchange listings. Trading will begin on April 27, with the XRPH AI rewards system activating on April 28, enabling users to earn rewards through real engagement within the ecosystem.

📢 Official Twitter Announcement:
https://x.com/xrphealthcare/status/2047598889524514892?s=46
